nodes.title: C1 item 6, M1: the whiteboard motion family beyond move. rotate (deg about a point), scale (k = [kx, ky] about a point; negative = mirror/fold), follow (a path of offsets, even speed by length), sweep (a filled shape's fill revealed from one side), morph (a stroke's/polygon's points to new ones). Each targets an earlier op of the script, only of the kinds it may (MOTION_TARGETS: text, labels and number work are only ever translated), and is REFUSED (not clamped) when the target would end off the board. Affine motions compose in script order (motionMatrix); the Player draws a moved op under one SVG matrix with stroke width divided back by the scale; settledScript/finalOp give the end board, which W19 gates (an arm turned onto a word is refused). Reduced motion: a started motion is at its end. Recordings docs/design/round7/studio/motion-{angle,area,cycle}-* (hand-built demos in evals/studio-timing/motion-demos.mjs); M2 puts the motion into the code templates.

md.decisions:
## dc-r7-motion-family: boards that turn, fill, travel and fold (2026-11-04)

The whiteboard can now turn a line (an angle opening), fill a shape from one side (area filling row by row), carry a dot along a path (a droplet through the water cycle), flip a shape (a fold) and reshape a drawing, in addition to sliding. Nothing ever moves off the board, and the finished board is checked like any other.
